page.notes: The text is a heavily shadowed, faded scan; many words in the right portion and the margin notes are illegible and are transcribed only approximately or left unmarked. Marginal notes on the left include references such as Baron. T. 7, Cedrenus, Niceph. l. 17, Zonaras, Caranza in Concil., and others, which are not fully legible.
